system.description:
The async intuitively understands a weak point in a structure, device, body, or opponent’s defenses. If they succeed in a COG x 3 Test, they gain a +30 on their next attempt to exploit that flaw. This could be applied to a called shot, a Demolitions Test to plant explosives, or a Hardware: Electronics Test to disable a communications array, and so on. This sleight is so far exclusive to those infected by the vittrad exovirus strain (p. 178).

Source: X-Risks, p. 180.
